tools.name: check_x402_seller
tools.description: Look up vet402's published purchase record for one x402 URL. Read-only. It does not pay. Pass url: the absolute https x402 URL. check_x402_seller shows what happened when vet402 paid an x402 URL: whether the payment settled, whether content came back, and the transaction where vet402 recorded one. F

tools.name: check_my_x402_endpoint
tools.description: Look up vet402's records for the x402 listings on one seller host. Read-only. It does not pay. Shows whether vet402 finds the endpoint in the catalogs it reads, what happened when vet402 paid it, and when vet402 can buy again. Pass any URL on your host. The answer covers the listings on that host as

tools.name: check_payment_proof
tools.description: Read a seller payment receipt on its chain. Read-only. It does not pay. Reads a seller PAYMENT-RESPONSE header, or a network and a transaction hash, on a chain vet402 reads again after a purchase. It returns whether the transaction is on that chain, plus from, to, asset and amount in atomic units. A

tools.name: check_8004_agent
tools.description: Look up one ERC-8004 feedback and whether its payment proof matches. Read-only. It does not pay. Pass agentId. Add client and feedbackIndex when the person names them. check_8004_agent loads one ERC-8004 Reputation Registry feedback on Base by default (chain eip155:8453), fetches its feedbackURI JSO

tools.name: find_x402_sellers
tools.description: Which x402 listings match these words and have a strong delivered record in the last 30 days? Read-only. It does not pay. Listings whose URL or description matches query, among those with at least one vet402 paid test in the last 30 days and a delivered rate of at least 80%. Order matches GET /api/v

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint, check_payment_proof, find_x402_sellers · Private data: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint, check_payment_proof, check_8004_agent, find_x402_sellers · Public sink: check_x402_seller, find_x402_sellers · Destructive: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint, check_payment_proof, find_x402_sellers · Private data: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint, check_payment_proof, check_8004_agent, find_x402_sellers · Public sink: check_x402_seller, find_x402_sellers · Destructive: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
